name: Bali Bliss Motion Studio 2.0
description:
Official launch video for Bali Bliss Studio 2.0 - Audio mode.

Generate music, SFX, and voceovers all from the one editor you already know.. One click gets you background music that fits your video perfectly, or ask Claude to be your sound designer.

assets.content: Make some deep house for me
Add a swoosh effect at each cut
And voiceovers stay editable, so your script can change as the video does.
Once your video's done, generate background music that matches its feeling. One click, and it just fits.
The whole project is shareable, so teammate feedback is one link away.
